title: Clonemask
summary: Clonemask is a spell that allows a Seeker to create a mask of someone's face to wear as a disguise.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
The spell was used and tested by Klaus. [TCG:OAL-088]

Zhalia Moon used this spell off-screen in King Solomon's mines to create masks of a pair of Rassimov's Suits for her and Dante Vale to wear as a disguise. Posing as the Suits, they led the Organization to another room, until the Professor figured out the decoy, to which Dante and Zhalia warned the rest of the team, removing their masks. [To Be Together]
